source: After logging out for a hot minute, and indulging in evil laughter, Sam logged back into the game and headed for the government office dealing with real estate.
target: Postquam brevi intervallo discessit et risu maligno indulgebat, Sam in ludum iterum accessit et ad officium gubernationis, quod rebus immobilibus curabat, processit.

source: He planned to buy a few properties, as all isekai'd people knew, the real power was in real estate.
target: Parare emere nonnullas possessiones cogitabat, nam omnes qui in alio mundo versabantur sciebant veram potentiam in rebus immobilibus esse.

source: Granted, Ironwood wasn’t the capital city, it was at most a mid-tier city in the Kingdom of Emerald Crown (they really like the color green, but the name came mostly from the emerald mine it was founded on), but naturally, Sam knew more than the average person.
target: Licet Ironwood caput urbis non esset, sed tantum urbs mediocris in Regno Corona Smaragdina (quod viridem colere amabant et nomen maius ex fodina smaragdi in qua condita erat orta habebat), sed scilicet, Sam plus quam homo mediocris sciebat.

source: By now, most people playing the game noticed that it lacked one important thing that almost all roleplaying games had.
target: Iam plerique lusores huius ludi animadvertērunt unum elementum maximi momenti, quod fere omnes ludi fabularum habebant, deficere.

source: Dungeons.
target: Carceres.

source: Magic Unbound had no dungeons.
target: Magic Unbound nullos carceres habebat.

source: No instanced content, no creepy caves to delve into, and nothing to farm.
target: Nec ullum contentum assignatum, nec speluncas horrendas explorandas, nec quidquam ad colligendum existimabat.

source: But as the game was extraordinary in its quality, nobody complained yet.
target: Quamquam ludus eximie in qualitate erat, nemo adhuc querelam efferre ausus est.

source: As they expected that a game of this magnitude would probably make them work for it.
target: Sicut speraverunt, ludus huius magnitudinis eos labore implicaret.

source: As Sam walked through the crowded streets of Ironwood, he couldn’t help but grin when thinking about how the developers would implement the dungeon system.
target: Dum Sam per vias densas Ironwoodi ambulabat, non potuit non subridere, cogitans quomodo programmatores systema carcerum instituere conarentur.

source: The first event of Magic Unbound.
target: Primum eventum Magic Unbound.

source: The Fracture.
target: Fractio.

source: And the first thing it would do, after, of course, causing untold chaos everywhere, was making living around the capitals almost impossible.
target: Et primum, postquam scilicet ubique inenarrabilem turbam effecisset, id erat ut vita circa capita paene impossibilis fieret.

source: And not because they were destroyed or anything like that.
target: Et non quia illa deleatae essent aut similia.

source: No, instead the greed of players and NPCs would make living there impossible.
target: Immo, avaritia lusorum et characterum non ludentium vitam ibi paene impossibile reddere faceret.

source: Staying near a mid-tier city like Ironwood, for now, was much more profitable in the long term.
target: Habitare prope urbem mediocris ut Ironwood, pro tempore, in longum terminum multo lucrativius erat.

source: Plus, the quests were much easier to gather the required reputation to purchase a property.
target: Praeterea, inquisitiones multo facilius efficiebantur ad congregandam famam necessariam ad possessionem emendam.

source: Sam looked up at the building he arrived in front of, then nodded to himself, Lucky dutifully following him, while also curiously watching the people around them.
target: Sam aedificium, coram quo advenit, respexit, deinde sibi annuit, Lucky eum fideliter sequens atque homines circa eos curiose observans.

source: Stepping through the gate, he didn’t even take a few steps before somebody called out to him.
target: Per portam ingrediens, ne paucos passi quidem fecit, antea aliquis eum vocavit.

source: “Hey, you with the wolf! Stop right there!”
target: “Heus, tu cum lupo! Siste hic!”

source: Sam stopped and turned towards the speaker, who was one of the guards stomping toward them.
target: Sam sistit et se convertit ad loquentem, qui unus ex custodibus ad eos calcans accessit.

source: “Yes, sir? Is there any problem?” he asked politely.
target: «Ita, domine? Estne quaestio?» inquit comiter.

source: The guard, grumpy and glaring at him, stood in front of him and exclaimed.
target: Custos, acerbe eum intuentis, ante eum stetit et exclamavit.

source: “Indeed. Pets are not permitted in the Area Bureau! You either have to leave your animal out here or can’t enter.”
target: «Revera, animalia domestica in Officio Regionis non permittuntur! Aut animal vestrum hic relinquere debetis, aut intrare non potestis.»

source: Sam stared at the guard for a second, then shrugged and turned to Lucky.
target: Sam custodem paulisper intuebatur, deinde umeros levavit et ad Lucky se convertit.

source: “Lucky, be nice and wait for me here.”
target: «Lucky, sis benignus et hic mihi exspecta.»

source: Lucky instantly plopped down where he was, tongue lolling out, giving Sam a wolfish grin.
target: Lucky statim locum suum occupavit, lingua erosa, Samo risum lupinum praebens.

source: Sam chuckled and returned his attention to the guard with a raised eyebrow.
target: Sam subridens animam suam ad custodem rediit, supercilium levatum in vultu gestans.

source: “Will that suffice?”
target: «Hoc satis est?»

source: The guard, still grumpy but a little surprised, nodded.
target: Custos, adhuc acerbus sed paulo obstupefactus, annuit.

source: “Er, yes. That’ll do.” And with that, he did an about‐face, probably to return to his station.
target: «Er, ita. Id sufficit.» Et ita, se vertit, fortasse ad stationem suam redire.

source: Sam just shrugged, gave Lucky another look, and continued towards the building.
target: Sam indifferenter umeros levavit, Lucky iterum aspexit, et ad aedificium processit.

source: The Area Bureau, was a giant building, at least compared to the buildings back in Greenwood, with at least five stories above ground, and who knows how many underground.
target: Officium Regionis erat ingens aedificium, saltem comparatum ad aedificia in Greenwood, cum quinque tabulatis super terram et plurimis sub terra.

source: It was decorated in the same vein as all buildings in Ironwood. With iron and wood.
target: Decoratum erat eodem stilo ac omnia aedificia Ironwood, ferro et ligno.

source: ‘Very original…’ Sam thought as he beheld the wrought iron columns and wooden inlays everywhere.
target: ‘Valde originaliter…’ cogitavit Sam, dum columnas ferreas et incrustationes ligneas ubique contemplabatur.

source: Still, he had set a task for himself, and no bad interior (and exterior) design would distract him from it.
target: Tamen sibi propositum statuit, nec mala structura interioris (nec exterioris) eum a proposito distraxit.

source: Thankfully, the part of the building he entered wasn’t filled with people rushing around, trying to swim against the relentless tides of bureaucracy, as it was the Property Acquisition wing of the building.
target: Gratias Deo, pars aedificii quam intravit non erat plena hominibus festinantibus contra fluctus inexorabiles bureaucratiae contendentibus, quoniam pars ad possessionum acquisitionem designata erat.

source: More than likely several people tried their luck here, but according to Sam’s memories of watching the internet and game historians analyze the past property trends of the game, most of the players who could afford (or think they could afford) buying lands were heading for the capital.
target: Verisimiliter plures hic fortunam temptaverunt, sed secundum memorias Sam de interrete et historicos ludorum spectantes, plerique lusores qui terras emere poterant (aut putabant se posse) versus caput tendebant.

source: And, of course, there were the quest requirements.
target: Et, scilicet, requisita inquisitionum erant.

source: He quickly stepped into the thankfully very short line, and barely a minute later, an exceptionally dressed young lady was leading him through the registration.
target: Celeriter in ordinem, qui ad gratias brevissimus erat, ingressus est, et vix post unam minutas, iuvenis femina egregie vestita eum per modum inscriptionis ducebat.

source: “Now that is finished, good sir,” the young woman spoke up with a polite smile after organizing the papers on her side of the counter.
target: «Iam consummatum est, bone domine,» inquit iuvenis femina cum risu comiter, postquam chartas in parte sua mensae disposuit.

source: “There are some issues that I must bring to your attention.”
target: «Sunt quaedam res, quas tibi notitiam afferre debeo.»

source: Sam just smirked at her.
target: Sam eam leviter subridens aspexit.

source: “I don’t have enough reputation to purchase land in the city. Right?”
target: «Non mihi satis famae est ad terram in urbe emendam, nonne?»

source: The woman blinked in surprise, but her training must have been great, as she immediately recovered and gave him another smile.
target: Femina stupens, sed disciplina eius praeclara, statim se redemit et ei iterum risum obtulit.

source: “Very good, sir. I’m glad you’ve done the research before contacting us.”
target: «Optime, domine. Gaudeo quod ante nos consulevistī.»

source: She took a little breath, then ran her eyes over him with Sam feeling as if the woman was looking through him.
target: Parum spiritum cepit, deinde oculos super eum traiecit, ita ut Sam sentiret eam quasi per eum intueri.

source: “So, if you know about that issue, then how may I help you?”
target: «Ita, si illam rem nosti, quomodo tibi auxilium ferre possim?»

source: Sam gave her his best smile.
target: Sam ei suum optimus risus dedit.

source: Though, based on the twinkle in the woman’s eyes, it really wasn’t working.
target: Sed ex scintilla in oculis eius plane non efficiebat.

source: “I was hoping… that you’d be able to point me in the right direction for increasing said reputation.”
target: «Sperabam ut mihi viam rectam indicares ad famam augendam.»

source: The administrator in front of him considered for a minute, and this time, Sam was pretty sure the pause was for the game to make a decision.
target: Administrator coram eo per minutum meditatus est, et hoc tempore Sam certus erat moram esse ad decisionem ludi faciendam.

source: Relationships with NPCs were tricky.
target: Relationes cum personis non lusoribus difficilia erant.

source: Your stats could affect it depending on the NPC, as well as your look, clothing, and such, just like in real life.
target: Status tui afficere poterant id secundum personam, simul atque habitus, vestitus, et similia, sicut in vita reali.

source: But the most important thing, for generic NPCs like this administrator woman, was how you treated them.
target: Sed res maximi momenti, pro characteribus genericis ut haec administratrix, erat quomodo eos tractares.

source: A lot of people tried but not many people could treat them like real people.
target: Multos conati sunt, sed pauci eos tamquam veros homines tractare potuerunt.

source: Understandably, even Sam struggled at the beginning, but thanks to Lucky (and the fluff) and the owner of the Green Stump inn, he could actually see the life in the NPCs.
target: Intelligenter, etiam Sam initio laboravit, sed gratias Lucky et domino cauponae "Green Stump", veram vitam in NPCs videre potuit.

source: Finally, the young woman nodded, and reached under the counter and retrieved a small pamphlet.
target: Denique, iuvenis femina annuit et sub mensa parvum libellum extraxit.

source: Sam carefully took it and gave the woman a thankful smile.
target: Sam id caute sustulit et feminae risum gratiam dedit.

source: Of course, the entire thing was a farce.
target: Certe, totum illud erat simulatio.

source: He knew every way he could increase his reputation, from hunting down bounties of bandits to finding metal deposits or even finding ancient seeds of the trees the city was named after.
target: Sciebat omnes vias ad famam suam augendam, a venatione praemiis latronum ad inveniendas fodinas metallorum aut etiam ad inveniendas seminas antiquas arborum, quibus urbs nominata erat.

source: But as always, there was no shortcut taking with Magic Unbound.
target: Sed ut semper, nullum iter brevius cum Magic Unbound invenire poterat.

source: At least until he could assemble a proper information network.
target: Saltem donec retiacula informationis apta constituere possit.

source: But that was far away… For now, he had to follow the same path as the other players…
target: Sed id longe erat... Interim autem, idem iter ac ceteri lusores sequi debebat.

source: ‘Isekai'd, and even got foreknowledge, and I can barely do anything about it…’ he grumbled to himself as he said goodbye to the woman, and went to find Lucky.
target: “Isekai factus sum, et etiam praenotitiam adeptus, et vix aliquid facere possum…” murmurat, dum feminae vale dicit et ad Lucky se contulit.

source: However, as he stepped out to the courtyard patrolled by grumpy guards, what he saw caused him to stop in surprise.
target: Sed cum in atrium, quod a custodibus iratis vigilandum erat, egressus est, ea quae vidit eum in stupore sisti fecerunt.

source: Out in the courtyard, surrounded by several confused guards, dressed differently than the guards of the Bureau was Lucky, who was currently at the mercy of a young noble lady based on her clothing.
target: In atrio, circumdatus a pluribus confusis custodibus, diversis ab illis in Officio, erat Lucky, qui nunc sub potestate iuvenis nobilis feminae, cuius vestimenta erant, versabatur.

source: “Who is a good boy? Who is?”
target: «Quis est bonus puer? Quis est?»

source: She exclaimed softly as she kept scratching Lucky’s belly, while the wolf rolled around on the ground, his entire body radiating happiness and satisfaction.
target: Ea leniter exclamavit, dum Lucky ventrem eius leniter scabicabat, et lupus in terra revolvens totum corpus laetitia et satisfactione efferebat.

source: Sam looked on, trying to identify the young woman.
target: Sam spectabat, conans iuvenem feminam agnoscerere.

source: She was definitely a teenager, dressed in very high-quality clothing, that screamed nobility and not even the garden variety.
target: Illa certe adulescens erat, vestita vestimentis optimae qualitatis, quae nobilitatem clamabant et non vulgarem.

source: She had long blonde hair, an appropriately aristocratic face, thin lips, cute button nose, and as she worked on sending Lucky into wolf heaven, Sam could see her deep brown eyes.
target: Illa capillos longos flavos habebat, vultum aristocraticum, labra tenuia, nasum parvum ac venustum, et dum Lucky in caelum lupinum mittere conabatur, Sam oculos eius fuscos profundos videbat.

source: Still, nowhere in his memories could he find her.
target: Sed nusquam in memoria eius eam invenire potuit.

source: And Sam was sure that a future beauty like her, in the later stages of the game, would have been memorable enough.
target: Et Sam certus erat quod pulchritudo futura talis, in posteris ludorum gradibus, satis memorabilis futurus esset.

source: ‘Lucky, you are really my lucky charm… the only thing to decide if you are a good luck or a bad luck charm…’ he grumbled, then began walking towards his pet.
target: ‘Lucky, vere es meus amuletum fortunae… sola res quae determinat num sis bonus vel malus talismanus…’ murmurat, deinde ad pet suum ambulare coepit.

source: The moment he started walking, the guards tensed, but he just nodded at them, then called out.
target: Mox ut ambulare coepit, custodes nervosi facti sunt, sed ipse eis annuit, deinde vocavit.

source: “Hey, Lucky! Have you been good?”
target: «Heus, Lucky! Fuisti bonus?»

source: The wolf, hearing his voice, froze for a moment, stopping his happy wriggling, while the young woman also froze.
target: Lupus, vocem eius audiens, paulisper immobilis factus est, et motus eius hilaris cessavit, dum iuvenis femina similiter sistit.

source: Then Lucky twisted his head so he could look up at Sam gave him a wolfish grin, then returned his attention to the still frozen young woman, batting at her hand as a small kitten would.
target: Tum Lucky caput vertit ut Sam intueretur, lupinum risum ei dedit, et deinde attentionem suam ad iuvenem feminam adhuc immobilis redegit, manu eius pulsando sicut parva felis.

source: Sam just snorted.
target: Sam tantum sufflatus est.

source: Truly, a fearsome and murderous creature. The king of the forest…
target: Revera, formidabilis et caedis appetens creatura; rex silvarum…

source: He turned towards the girl and gave a short bow.
target: Se ad puellam convertit et brevem inclinavit.

source: “I apologize, my lady. I hope Lucky wasn’t bothering you?”
target: «Ignosce, domina mea; spero Lucky te non molestavisse.»

source: The girl let out a small breath and, to Lucky’s devastation, stood up, patting her dress a little, then turned her gaze at Sam.
target: Puella parum suspiravit, deinde surrexit, vestem leviter tangens, et oculos ad Sam convertit.

source: “Not at all, good sir. I was just waiting on my father.”
target: «Minime, bone domine; solum patrem meum exspectabam.»

source: She glanced down at the almost silently whining wolf.
target: Ea deorsum aspexit ad lupum, qui paene silentio gemebat.

source: “Lucky you say? A good name.”
target: «Lucky, dicis? Bonum nomen est.»

source: She murmured, then continued. “Lucky was just keeping me company.”
target: Ea murmuravit, deinde dixit: «Lucky mihi solum socius erat.»

source: Sam gave her a smile and nodded.
target: Sam ei risum obtulit et annuit.

source: “He is good at that, my lady. Perhaps I could bring him around later for you to play with? After all, even fearsome wolves like Lucky need to relax…”
target: «Id bene facit, domina mea. Forsitan postea eum tibi ad ludendum adferre possum? Quippe etiam lupi formidabiles ut Lucky requiescere indigent…»

source: The young girl giggled at him, calling the wolf on the ground fearsome, and dipped her head a little.
target: Iuvenis puella subridens eum aspexit, lupum in terra formidolosum appellans, et caput leviter inclinavit.

source: She opened her mouth, probably to answer him, but they were interrupted by a boisterous yell.
target: Ea os aperuit, ut forsitan illi responderet, sed clamor tumultuosus eos interpellavit.

source: “Lucrecia!”
target: «Lucrecia!»

source: Sam watched as a man, taller than him by several heads, and shoulders wide enough to use as a billboard, the noble clothing almost stretched to its utmost limit on his muscled form.
target: Sam spectabat virum, pluribus capitibus eum superantem, et umeris latioribus, cuius vestimenta nobilia fere ad summum corporis musculosum extulerunt.

source: Sam’s gaming senses were practically screaming at him that this was an important NPC.
target: Sensus ludendi Sam fere illi nuntiabant, "hic character non lusor magni momenti est!"

source: Though, the fact there was no mention of this man in his inherited memories, as the history of Ironwood was pretty well documented, confused him.
target: Sed quod de hoc viro in memoria sua non apparuerat, cum historia Ironwood bene scripta esset, eum confundebat.

source: He watched as the giant man fussed over his daughter, and he simply made eye contact with the girl and mouthed ‘Lucrecia?’ at her.
target: Observavit virum ingentem filiam curare, et cum puella oculos eius convenirent, labris "Lucrecia?" insinuavit.

source: She just rolled her eyes back at him, while reassuring her father, that no it wasn’t torturing to wait for five minutes.
target: Ea oculos reiecit ad eum, dum patrem suum rassurabat, dicens quinque minuta exspectare non esse cruciatum.

source: Then the man finally deigned to notice Sam.
target: Tum vir tandem dignatus est Sam animadverti.

source: “You!” he yelled, apparently only knowing how to communicate at ear-shattering levels, and pointing at Sam.
target: «Tu!» exclamavit, cum videnter sciret loqui voce fragoris aurium percussa, digito ad Sam monstrans.

source: “My daughter told me that your pet has entertained her!”
target: «Filia mea mihi narravit petum tuum eam delectavisse!»

source: Sam simply bowed his head once again.
target: Sam iterum caput inclinavit.

source: “Yes, my lord. Lucky is good at that. Back in Greenwood, he used to run around with the local kids.”
target: «Ita, domine. Lucky id bene facit; in Greenwood cum pueris localibus circumiabatur.»

source: “Ah-ha! I see!” yelled the man, looking between him, the wolf, and his hopeful-looking daughter.
target: «Ah-ha! Intelligo!» exclamavit, inter eum, lupum, et filiam eius, quae spe plena videbatur, intuebatur.

source: “She also tells me that you have offered to visit us so that my darling daughter – “Father!” – could continue to be entertained by him!”
target: «Ea etiam mihi narrat te nos visitaturum esse, ut filia mea cara – "Pater!" – ab eo delectari possit!»

source: “That is correct, my lord. Lucky seems to like your daughter, and if he likes her, then he likes her. Who am I to stand in their way?” he finished with a wry grin.
target: «Recte, domine. Lucky videtur tuam filiam diligere; et si eam amat, ideo eam amat. Quis ego sum, ut in via eorum stetim?» finivit cum risu ironico.

source: The noble stared at him for a second, then threw his head back and began to laugh. Loudly, of course.
target: Nobilis eum per momentum aspexit, tum caput retraxit et risum incoepit, clamore stridente.

source: “Excellent! Then come to the Silvercrest manor in a week’s time, young adventurer, and we shall have you as a guest!”
target: «Optime! Ergo veni ad manerium Silvercrest intra hebdomadam, iuvenis adventor, et te hospitem habebimus!»

source: He turned around and immediately began to walk away, not even waiting for Sam to answer.
target: Se vertit et statim processit, nec Sam responsum dare exspectans.

source: “Come, Lucrecia! Your mother must be waiting!”
target: «Veni, Lucrecia! Mater tua certe te exspectat!»

source: Lucrecia looked at him with an apologetic smile, and gave Lucky a fond look, then hurried after her father, their guards quickly following them.
target: Lucrecia eum aspiciens cum risu excusato, Lucky amantissime aspexit, et deinde celeriter post patrem suum processit, custodes eos celeriter sequentes.

source: Sam stood there for a minute, ignoring the pitying or jealous looks from the guards of the Bureau while he searched his memories for the name Silvercrest.
target: Sam ibi per unam minuta stetit, vultus miseritatis aut invidiae a custodibus Bureau neglex, dum nomen Silvercrest in memoria quaerebat.

source: Finally, after a few minutes of frantic search, he found it.
target: Denique, post paucos minutos fervidae quaestionis, id invenit.

source: ‘Ooooh… Now it makes sense…’ he thought.
target: ‘Ooooh… nunc sensum reddit…’ cogitavit.

source: Then, shaking his head, Sam motioned for Lucky and left the area with great haste.
target: Tum, caput concutens, Sam Lucky signavit et area celeriter reliquit.

source: It was finally time to upgrade Lucky.
target: Tandem tempus erat Lucky emendandi.

source: And as he left the courtyard, he checked out his latest quest.
target: Et dum atrium reliquit, novissimum quaestionem inspexit.

source: [New quest acquired!]
target: [Nova quaestio acquisita!]

source: [Visit of the highest order!]
target: [Visitatio ordinis altissimi!]

source: [Lord Silvercrest has appreciated that your pet managed to get his only daughter to smile. He wants you to visit him in a week and do it again (and won’t take a no as an answer). Bide your time, and visit his manor at the appropriate time.]
target: [Dominus Silvercrest aestimavit quod petum tuum filiam suam unicam eam delectavisse. Vult ut eum intra hebdomadam visites et id iterum facias (nec "non" ut responsum accipiet). Tempore adsiste et manerium eius tempore opportuno visita.]

source: [Time limit: A week]
target: [Tempus limite: Hebdomada]

source: [Penalty: Failure to present yourself at the correct time will result in Lord Silvercrest hunting you down.]
target: [Poena: Si te in tempore apto non praesentes, Dominus Silvercrest te insequetur.]

source: ‘A curse or opportunity?’ he wondered as finished reading while rejoining the crowds tussling in the street.
target: ‘Maledictio an occasio?’ meditatus est, cum lecturam finiret et se cum turbā in via congregatā reiunxit.

source: As he already had access to a ritual room, he simply went by the mage tower and reserved one of the neutral ritual rooms, then began to hunt for materials.
target: Cum iam ad conclave ritualis accessum haberet, per turrim magorum processit et unum ex conclavibus ritualibus neutris reservavit, deinde materias quaerere coepit.

source: Truly, he could have waited until he managed to gather ultra-super rare materials, but that would fall into the shortcut territory, and the system would penalize him for it.
target: Revera, exspectare potuisset donec materias ultra-super raras colligeret, sed id in viam brevius celeri pertinebat, et ratio eum poena afficere debebat.

source: So for now, he was working with the highest material that somebody could have intuited based on his previous actions.
target: Ita interim, laborabat cum materia altissima, quam quis ex actis eius praeteritis coniecturam habere potuisset.

source: A few magically charged crystals to provide power.
target: Pauca crystallina magicae impetu repleta ad vim praebendam.

source: A few vials of blood from swamp shadow murks, a fang from a shadow wolf, and a tiny piece of mithril, famous for being the best at conducting magic.
target: Pauca vasa sanguinis ex paludose umbris murkorum, dente ex lupo umbrato, et parva pars mithrili, nota propter optimum in magica ductura.

source: Though they were just mere additions.
target: Licet ea tantum additamenta erant.

source: In reality, upgrading a pet at this level only needed one thing.
target: In re, emendatio pet ex hoc gradu solum unum rem requirebat.

source: An essence. Something related to the preferred evolution.
target: Essentia. Aliquid ad evolutionem praeferendam pertinentis.

source: If you wanted to evolve something that was made of metal? An Elemental core…
target: Si aliquid ex metallo factum evolvere velis? Nucleus elementalis…

source: You wanted your pet to fly? Air elemental core, or maybe the essence of some flying magical creature…
target: Si pet tuum volare velis, nucleus aeri elementalis, aut fortasse essentia alicuius creaturae magicae volantis…

source: And wouldn’t you know? He had found a shadow spirit just lying around…
target: Et nonne scires? Spiritum umbrarum iacentem invenerat…

source: Grinning to himself, followed by Lucky, Sam eagerly climbed the stairs of the mage tower towards his rented ritual room, while leafing through the small booklet the receptionist handed him.
target: Subridens ad se ipso, Lucky sequens, Sam aviditer scalas turrim magorum ascendit ad conclave ritualis locatum, dum per parvum libellum, quod receptrix ei tradiderat, perlegebat.

source: It contained the basic rules of the ritual rooms, the dos and don’ts of rituals, and a few basic rituals that everybody should know.
target: Continebat regulas fundamentales conclavorum ritualium, quae qua facienda et qua non facienda sint, atque paucos ritus fundamentales quos omnes scire debent.

source: He couldn’t wait…
target: Non poterat exspectare…
